subject: Operational runthrough: model-tiering lab & load rehearsal - scheduling
messages:
From: Oliver Park <ops@orbitai.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elaine Zhou <elaine@orbitai.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Operational runthrough: model-tiering lab & load rehearsal - initial ask

Hi Lukas,

Thanks for the quick sync last week. OrbitAI would like to lock a half-day window for the hands-on model-tiering lab and load rehearsal as part of the POC kickoff. High level asks:

- Prompt review (two prompt families)
- Model selection walk (re-tested quantized variants)
- Routing/fallback rehearsal across EU regions
- Token-level load test (simulate 300 rps spikes)

Our team can do the week of Apr 12–16. Preferred windows are mornings CET (0800–1200 CET) to align with engineering availability. Can Redwood propose two distinct slots (one nominal full run + one fallback rehearsal) and confirm what artifacts you need ahead of time?

Attaching our internal list of test prompts (attached as prompt_set_orbit.txt) and a short network topology note.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Oliver Park
Head of Platform
OrbitAI

Attachments: prompt_set_orbit.txt (text), network-note.md (text)

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Park <ops@orbitai.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 12:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Operational runthrough: model-tiering lab & load rehearsal - initial ask

Hi Oliver — thanks for the detail. 

We can run two candidate half-day windows next week:

1) Tue Apr 13, 08:00–12:30 CET (primary run)
2) Thu Apr 15, 08:00–12:30 CET (fallback + failover rehearsal)

Agenda we propose (half-day):
- 08:00–08:20: Introductions + goals (Redwood + OrbitAI engineering)
- 08:20–09:30: Prompt review + baseline model runs (we'll share token counts)
- 09:30–10:30: Model selection & quantized variant verification
- 10:30–11:30: Routing policy workshop (region mapping, tiering, fallback rules)
- 11:30–12:15: Load test rehearsal (scale to target traffic, KV caching checks)
- 12:15–12:30: Action items & next steps

Prep items we'll need from you by EOD Apr 9:
- Final prompt set (you sent initial; please confirm canonical list)
- Representative payload sizes for token estimation
- Any egress/network constraints for your EU region

Sofia will lead the routing policy workshop and validate the fallback rules; Rishi will own load-test orchestration. I'll generate a runbook + tentative calendar invites and share them by EOD Apr 6.

Would you like the primary run on the 13th or should we pick the 15th as nominal?

Best,
Lukas
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: none

From: Oliver Park <ops@orbitai.com>

Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 07:44:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Operational runthrough: model-tiering lab & load rehearsal - initial ask

Lukas — thanks, that agenda looks good. We prefer Tue Apr 13 as the primary run. A few clarifying items:

- For the fallback rehearsal, can you simulate the cross-region failover (eu-west -> eu-north) and demonstrate the behavior of prefix cache vs. cold-starts?
- During model selection, please include at least one 4-bit quantized variant and call out expected latency deltas (p50/p95).
- For load testing, our infra team will provide a short YAML with payload size distributions by Apr 9.

We'll confirm the final prompt set by Apr 9 and share the load YAML. Please go ahead and send the runbook + invites.

Oliver

Subject: Re: Operational runthrough: model-tiering lab & load rehearsal - scheduling confirmed

Thanks — locking Tue Apr 13, 08:00–12:30 CET as the primary run. Summary and next steps below.

Calendar: I've sent a calendar invite (redwood-calendar-invite.ics) for Apr 13 08:00–12:30 CET — please accept.

Runbook snapshot (attached): runbook_v1.pdf — includes checklist, contact points, and rollback play. Key notes:
- Cross-region failover: Sofia will perform eu-west -> eu-north failover using policy tier 2; we'll demonstrate prefix cache warmup sequence and expected cold-start penalty (~+120ms p50 for the quantized 4-bit variant).
- Model variants: baseline fp16 (baseline latency), 8-bit quant, and recommended 4-bit candidate (performance trade-offs called out in runbook).
- Load testing: Rishi will run a staged ramp to 300 rps bursts, with a 5-minute soak at target, measuring token cost and latency signals.

Prep items due Apr 9 (receipt acknowledged):
- Final prompt set (OrbitAI) — received Apr 6 14:02 CET
- Load YAML (OrbitAI infra) — expected Apr 9 (please reply to this thread when posted)
- Any IP allowlist changes — if needed, please email infra@redwood.ai with source IPs

Attachments: runbook_v1.pdf (pdf), load-plan.csv (csv), redwood-calendar-invite.ics (calendar)

If anything changes on your side (ops windows or additional stakeholders), flag here and we'll re-open slots. Otherwise we'll treat Thu Apr 15 as the fallback rehearsal slot and keep it tentatively reserved.

Cheers,
Lukas
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
